name: Ações pós-incidente
description: Post-mortem and follow-up actions (ADR-0035): file what must be done after an incident or a conversation, linked to the incident, with owner, priority, due date and status (aberta, em curso, feita, descartada); update, close and list them. Butler's source of truth for follow-ups — written by tools, never only in a model's memory.
